    backorders = [[] for _ in range(P)]
    pending = [[] for _ in range(P)]
    arrival_counter = 0
    shipped = 0
    earned = 0
    discarded = 0
    cancelled = 0
    supplies = 0

        return sum(lot[0] for lot in lots[p])

    def take_stock(p, q):
        nonlocal shipped, earned
        if q <= 0:
            return 0
        lots[p].sort(key=lambda x: (x[1], x[2]))
        taken = 0
        new_lots = []
        for lot in lots[p]:
            if q == 0:
                new_lots.append(lot)
                continue
            if lot[0] <= q:
                taken += lot[0]
                q -= lot[0]
            else:
                lot[0] -= q
                taken += q
                q = 0
                new_lots.append(lot)
        lots[p] = new_lots
        shipped += taken
        earned += taken * price[p]
        return taken

    def fill_backorders(p):
        while backorders[p] and stock_total(p) > 0:
            qty, day = backorders[p][0]
            taken = take_stock(p, qty)
            if taken == 0:
                break
            if taken == qty:
                backorders[p].pop(0)
            else:
                backorders[p][0][0] -= taken
                break

    def add_lot(p, qty, expiry):
        nonlocal arrival_counter
        if qty <= 0:
            return
        lots[p].append([qty, expiry, arrival_counter])
        arrival_counter += 1
        fill_backorders(p)

    def ship_order(p, qty, day):
        if backorders[p]:
            backorders[p].append([qty, day])
        else:
            taken = take_stock(p, qty)
            rem = qty - taken
            if rem > 0:
                backorders[p].append([rem, day])

    eidx = 0
    E = len(ev_day)
    for d in range(days):
        # 1 discard
        for p in range(P):
            new_lots = []
            for lot in lots[p]:
                if lot[1] < d:
                    discarded += lot[0]
                else:
                    new_lots.append(lot)
            lots[p] = new_lots

        # 2 supplies due
        for p in range(P):
            arrived = []
            remaining = []
            for due in pending[p]:
                if due == d:
                    arrived.append(due)
                else:
                    remaining.append(due)
            pending[p] = remaining
            for _ in arrived:
                add_lot(p, rq[p], d + shelf[p])

        # 3 events
        while eidx < E and ev_day[eidx] == d:
            kind = ev_kind[eidx]
            p = ev_prod[eidx]
            qty = ev_qty[eidx]
            if kind == 1:
                expiry = ev_expiry[eidx]
                add_lot(p, qty, expiry)
            else:
                ship_order(p, qty, d)
            eidx += 1

            for q, placed in backorders[p]:
                if placed <= cutoff:
                    cancelled += q
                else:
                    new_q.append([q, placed])
            backorders[p] = new_q

                supplies += 1

    owed = 0
    for p in range(P):
        for q, _ in backorders[p]:
            owed += q
    return (stock, earned, shipped, discarded, cancelled, supplies, owed)

    l2 = [[] for _ in range(s2)]

    l1_misses = 0
    l2_hits = 0
    l2_misses = 0
    mem_reads = 0
    mem_writes = 0

        set_idx = block % s2
        st = l2[set_idx]
        if len(st) >= w2:
            evicted = st.pop(0)
            if evicted[1]:
                mem_writes += 1
        st.append([block, dirty])

        set_idx = block % s1
        st = l1[set_idx]

            evicted_block, evicted_dirty = st.pop(0)
            if evicted_dirty:
                sidx2 = evicted_block % s2
                st2 = l2[sidx2]
                idx2 = -1
                for i, entry in enumerate(st2):
                    if entry[0] == evicted_block:
                        idx2 = i
                        break
                if idx2 != -1:
                    entry = st2.pop(idx2)
                    entry[1] = True
                    st2.append(entry)
                else:
                    insert_l2(evicted_block, True)
        st.append([block, dirty])

        idx1 = -1
        for i, entry in enumerate(l1[set1]):
            if entry[0] == a:
                idx1 = i
                break
        if idx1 != -1:
            l1_hits += 1
            entry = l1[set1].pop(idx1)
            if w:
                entry[1] = True
            l1[set1].append(entry)
        else:
            l1_misses += 1
            set2 = a % s2
            idx2 = -1
            for i, entry in enumerate(l2[set2]):
                if entry[0] == a:
                    idx2 = i
                    break
            if idx2 != -1:
                l2_hits += 1
                entry = l2[set2].pop(idx2)
                l2[set2].append(entry)
            else:
                l2_misses += 1
                mem_reads += 1
                insert_l2(a, False)
            insert_l1(a, w)

    dirty = 0
    for st in l1:
        for entry in st:
            if entry[1]:
                dirty += 1
    for st in l2:

            if entry[1]:
